description.value: Lentelus Farms is a sustainable, agroecological mixed livestock operation in Courtenay's Comox Valley, running a farm stand described as sitting 'right in the middle of town.' Cyclists can stock up on free-range meats (chicken, pork, beef, lamb), fresh eggs, handmade sourdough bread, wildflower honey, and seasonal vegetables. The farm practices regenerative agriculture and its flooded fields serve as winter habitat for the recovering Trumpeter Swan population.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active farm stand at 1300 Comox Road, Courtenay, BC, selling free-range meats, eggs, sourdough bread, wildflower honey, and seasonal vegetables year-round, supporting 'Basic groceries' as true. No evidence anywhere on the website or in OSM tags regarding bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cycling-specific infrastructure, so those remain null. Phone (250.218.4640) and address (1300 Comox Road, Courtenay) match between OSM and website, with the website adding the full postal code V9N 3P8.
concerns: OSM name is 'Lentelus Farm Stand' but the business website consistently uses 'Lentelus Farms' — minor branding discrepancy.
OSM address omits city and postal code; website confirms full address as 1300 Comox Road, Courtenay, BC V9N 3P8.
Business also operates a second location in Kelowna (3652 Spiers Road) with abattoir and emergency livestock services — OSM record is specifically for the Courtenay farm stand.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, year-round farm stand in central Courtenay offering a broad range of fresh groceries; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists riding the Comox Valley.

Basic groceries.detail: Year-round supply of free-range poultry, pork, beef, lamb, eggs, handmade sourdough bread, wildflower honey, and seasonal vegetables sold at the farm stand and online for pickup
